not_found.detail: PartiQL is documented (ql-reference) as a SQL-compatible language with the same performance as other data plane operations; no saved AWS page says whether it adds joins across tables. Looked in ql-reference, HowItWorks.API, www/dynamodb/faqs.

Source contradicts the expectation for DAX: DAX.concepts says strongly consistent reads are passed through to DynamoDB and not cached; DAX does not make them eventually consistent. GSI and streams reads are eventually consistent only (fact dynamodb-gsi-and-streams-reads-eventual). MREC strong reads can be stale across Regions (dynamodb-mrec-strong-reads-may-be-stale).

Which global tables version the console creates is not stated in V2globaltables_versions, GlobalTables, globaltables-CoreConcepts or V2globaltables_HowItWorks. The pages only say to use version 2019.11.21 (Current) whenever possible.

No saved AWS page states that a table is a Regional resource whose name is unique only per account and Region. www/dynamodb/faqs says single-account global table replicas share one name; HowItWorks.NamingRulesDataTypes gives only length and character rules.
HTTPS and TLS facts added (dynamodb-https-default-ssl-tls); FIPS endpoints for DynamoDB appear only in the dual-stack endpoints page of the full guide index, which is not a saved page.

The AmazonDynamoDBFullAccess_v2 change is only in a DocumentHistory table row that holds a Markdown link, so no mechanical quote is possible from the behavior lens; the decisions+changes lens owns it.
globaltables-security says replicas must use the same TYPE of KMS key; it does not say whether two customer managed keys in different Regions must differ.

partial.detail: Service deletion marker covered by dynamodb-ttl-deletes-appear-in-streams-as-service; the userIdentity type Service and principalId dynamodb.amazonaws.com fields appear in the page only as code bullets and JSON, which cannot be quoted.
The sentence about Lambda polling the stream four times per second starts with a Markdown link; retries, synchronous invoke and no GetRecords charge are covered.
The sentence saying exports do not consume read capacity units holds a Markdown link; PITR requirement, formats and incremental export are covered.

The list of settings not restored (auto scaling, IAM policies, alarms, tags, streams, TTL, deletion protection, PITR) is a bullet list after a sentence ending with a colon; only the tags fact was quotable.

notes: Other miners (numbers, decisions+changes, faq) filed facts with overlapping ids; the helper skipped ids already in the canon. Overlap is only in claims about PITR 35 days, restores to a new table, cross-Region restore and Vault Lock.
